title: MxAgile Verification Plan
description: Selects which evidence layers serve each proof point in a test contract, with rationale. Answers WHICH layers to run — not HOW the tests are technically implemented. Canonical location: planning/verification-plans/VPL-NNN.yaml. See policies/verification-layers.md and skills/verification-plan.md.

ID.description: Stable identifier. Must match filename stem: VPL-001.yaml -> ID: VPL-001.

test_contract_id.description: The test contract this plan covers.

wave_id.description: Wave this plan is scoped to, e.g. W01.

status.description: draft: being authored. active: approved, drives verification runs. superseded: replaced.

layer_assignments.description: One entry per proof point in the test contract.

regression_scope.description: Proof points promoted from earlier waves as regression candidates.

proof_point_id.description: References a proof_point.id in the test contract.

included.description: true: this layer MUST run for this proof point. false: explicitly excluded.

rationale.description: Why this layer is included or excluded. One sentence.

test_generation_hint.description: Optional hint for skills/test-generate.md: which mxcli command, which Playwright flow, which entity to DESCRIBE.

campaign_type.description: Which acceptance campaign type this proof point contributes to. See policies/acceptance-campaign.md.
